name: Egg Drop Problem
description: Find the minimum number of trials needed to determine the critical floor in a building with n floors and k eggs, in worst case.
aim: Minimize worst-case trials: dp[k][n] = min trials with k eggs and n floors. Use dp[k][m] = floors testable with k eggs in m moves.
howItWorks: Reframe: given k eggs and m moves, max floors you can test
Binary search on answer: find min m where dp[k][m] >= n

whenToUse: Binary search on answer with constraint
alternatives: Naive DP O(kn²) — simpler to understand
Binary search on moves — O(k log n)
